title: BlackRock Says AI Agents Could Be the Next Big Driver of Crypto Demand
summary: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock Says AI Agents Could Be the Next Big Driver of Crypto Demand The asset manager says that artificial intelligence and digital assets are converging, and that AI adoption may be an underappreciated source of demand for crypto. This post BlackRock Says AI Agents Could Be the Next Big Driver of Crypto Demand first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
